title: Establishment of District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission

content.scenario: The State Government of Karnataka wants to establish a consumer dispute redressal mechanism in each district of the state. It must establish a District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in each district by notification.
content.outcome: The State Government of Karnataka will establish a District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in each district of the state by notification, as required by law. The State Government may also establish more than one District Commission in a district if it deems fit.

user_queries: What is the procedure for establishing a District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission?
How does the State Government notify the establishment of a District Commission?
Can a state have more than one District Commission in a district?
